Upside down at about 73 m, listing onto one side of her armour belt: the narrow iron lower hull uppermost on the flat armoured raft, the anchor well forward, the stern cut open where the propeller, the engine and the turret were raised (1998-2002), hull plating and the grout bags of 2000 in the sand at the stern. Sixteen men died in her sinking.
